name: @ordin/zkyc-core-reference
description: Deterministic zKYC authority core with sanitized full-stack reference adapters

scripts.typecheck:workspaces: npm run build --silent && npm run typecheck -w @ordin/zkyc-core-api-reference && npm run build -w @ordin/zkyc-core-api-reference --silent && npm run typecheck -w @ordin/zkyc-sdk-reference && npm run build -w @ordin/zkyc-sdk-reference --silent && npm run typecheck -w @ordin/zkyc-operator-ui-reference && npm run typecheck -w @ordin/zkya-onboarding-reference
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:api && npm run test:sdk && npm run test:ui && npm run test:zkya && npm run test:security
scripts.test:api: npm run build --silent && npm run test -w @ordin/zkyc-core-api-reference
scripts.test:sdk: npm run build --silent && npm run build -w @ordin/zkyc-core-api-reference --silent && npm run test -w @ordin/zkyc-sdk-reference
scripts.test:ui: npm run build -w @ordin/zkyc-sdk-reference --silent && npm run test -w @ordin/zkyc-operator-ui-reference
scripts.test:zkya: npm run build -w @ordin/zkyc-sdk-reference --silent && npm run test -w @ordin/zkya-onboarding-reference
scripts.build:workspaces: npm run build --silent && npm run build -w @ordin/zkyc-core-api-reference && npm run build -w @ordin/zkyc-sdk-reference && npm run build -w @ordin/zkyc-operator-ui-reference && npm run build -w @ordin/zkya-onboarding-reference
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:workspaces
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run security:check && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:workspaces && npm test && npm run build:all && npm run test:browser && npm run package:check && npm audit --audit-level=high
